description: This file defines the `GenericResourceOwner` class within the League OAuth2 client library. The class implements the `ResourceOwnerInterface` and encapsulates a resource owner's response data, providing methods to retrieve the owner ID and full response as an array.

classes.name: GenericResourceOwner
classes.description: Represents a generic resource owner for use with the GenericProvider.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the resource owner with response data and resource owner ID.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the resource owner.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the raw response data as an array.
